name: Dennias
description: A young cathar trainee from the Elgaud Grounds who is corrupted by magenta tendrils and killed by Thalia.

description_citations.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares

timeline.summary: Dennias is overtaken by magenta tendrils from his body and Thalia kills him mercifully.
